graphEvents.label: Four host-hook runtimes share a three-process chain
Cache hit rate has no field telemetry

label: The exact prompt cache is in-memory in the daemon, 1000 entries, 5-minute TTL, keyed on canonical prompt plus source signature, workspace, runtime, token cap and thresholds; unique prompts miss by construction and the 44-prompt probe has a zero hit rate by design.
No field cache hit rate can be measured: diagnostic persistence needs SKILL_ADVISOR_DEBUG, cache counters need the metrics flag, and this checkout has no persisted diagnostics file.
A semantic cache pays one 6.57 ms embedding to decide a hit and then saves only the scorer work, while a wrong near-duplicate hit changes the recommendation, so it does not pay.

All four host-hook runtimes run three Node processes per prompt (host adapter, advisor hook, CLI); Codex passes 2800 ms and Devin and Cursor 10 s, while Claude's child gets 2200 ms and Codex's host kills at 3 s.
The three plugin runtimes run two processes because the host imports the advisor hook; Pi already calls the exported handler in-process with its own deadline, so the pattern is proven in production.

The removable unit across runtimes is the delegated advisor-hook spawn in the four host adapters: importing the same exported handler in-process saves one measured 36.85 ms Node start per prompt on Claude, Codex, Devin and Cursor.
The 5000 ms cold daemon wait fits only Devin's and Cursor's 10 s budgets, not Claude's 2200 ms child budget or Codex's 2800 ms adapter timeout, so the fail-open risk is Claude and Codex specific.
Nothing further is worth precomputing: 45 command vectors and 14 skill vectors are already built and the brief's directive block is constant, leaving only the once-per-session warm call.

direction: A semantic or near-duplicate prompt cache
reason: It pays one embedding to decide a hit and risks a wrong recommendation.

direction: Persist the exact cache across daemon restarts
reason: The daemon recycles on build staleness, not per prompt.

direction: New command or skill vector precompute
reason: Both are already built and the constant block is already deduped.

direction: Treat all six runtimes as one cold-start risk
reason: Only Claude and Codex have a budget tighter than the CLI cold wait.
